title: 防災行政無線のスピーカー柱
description: 地域に防災放送を流す、屋外拡声子局のスピーカー柱です。高さ約9.7mのコンクリート柱、上部の4方向のホーンスピーカーと金具・バンド、ソーラーパネル、配線管、柱脚の機器箱とアンテナを造形しています。放送や音響の機能、管理番号などの文字は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.859 × 10.100 × 1.859 m、5,232三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An outdoor public-address speaker pole used for municipal disaster warnings. It models a roughly 9.7 m concrete pole, four horn speakers on brackets and clamp bands near the top, a solar panel, a cable conduit, an equipment cabinet at the base and a small antenna mast. Broadcast or acoustic function and asset-number lettering are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.859 × 10.100 × 1.859 m; 5,232 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
